dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank; perimeters consist of sharp high-intensity white pixel borders transitioning from the dark background pelt to darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid-colored high-intensity pixel clusters located predominantly in the anterior neck region and along the lower lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-body form a scalene triangle, with a secondary curvilinear alignment of smaller blobs extending towards the posterior terminus.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical chain of high-contrast annular patches descending from the dorsal ridge toward the lateral midline.
